properties.description: After a synchronous reset edge both response valids are clear. Reset discards the entire prior scoreboard epoch; invalid payloads and input ready are not prescribed.
A blocked data presentation retains valid, data and last until acceptance or reset.
A blocked status presentation retains valid and every status field until acceptance or reset, independently of data readiness.

Every presented data byte, including blocked presentations, is justified by an already accepted prefix or completed-frame padding. After 128 uninterrupted no-offer, both-ready cycles, bounded tracked obligations must be drained.
Justified data presentations preserve ordered input bytes, append zero padding to length four, truncate at length eight, and assert last exactly on the expected final byte.

Every presented status corresponds to the next completed accepted input frame, with exact original length, clamped length and padding/truncation flags. Status consumption advances independently of data consumption.
